messages.author: slotherer
messages.text:
Random List of QoL suggestions:

1. What your population still needs (1 to fix) - can be moved close to the top. Include new line items: Unpowered, Unstable, Negative on Resources (from trading/factories)

2. A more comprehensive pre(?)-calculator? There's already an auto cost calculator for city/land, and in the mass purchase section, but not in individual provinces when buying buildings. Please remember to include to red out and let us know how much more of something is needed to complete our purchase.  Including calculation on sufficient manpower/workers would be great too - since that can really kill your entire economy

3. Across the board - don't kick us back to another page/tab. Happens to me all the time on #2 because I'm just trying to get the game to help me calculate but it only appears after, and meanwhile, kicks me back to province overview so I have to change tabs and type in my number again.

4. In Province view, please keep relevant info up top, like Power, City, Lands, so I don't have to keep going back to overview to check and then going back to Buildings / Mil / Res to build.


Not quite QoL - but Economic Balance seems all focused on Steel & Components for whatever reason. They are the only factories that need workers and Projects are mostly towards Steel.
